entries.label: n8n
entries.description: Fair-code visual workflow automation with strong AI/LLM integration and Azure DevOps support via community node. Excellent for glue workflows between AI services and DevOps.

entries.label: Activepieces
entries.description: Open-source AI-first automation platform with TypeScript-based 'pieces' framework, designed for AI workflows and agents. Strong candidate for TS-based extensions.

entries.label: Node-RED
entries.description: Veteran flow-based tool for integrations and IoT, with community AI nodes and easy JavaScript scripting. Rock-solid automation glue.

entries.label: Appsmith
entries.description: Open-source internal tools builder with self-hosted option. Connects to any REST API including AI and Azure DevOps. Great for DevOps dashboards.

entries.label: ToolJet
entries.description: OSS low-code internal tools platform with Azure Repos plugin, AI integration positioning, and rich component library. Very nice for DevOps control panel apps.

entries.label: Budibase
entries.description: OSS low-code app builder for internal tools, self-hostable with REST and automation support. Good for CRUD-heavy tools with DevOps/AI side actions.

entries.label: NocoDB
entries.description: OSS Airtable-like database on SQL with APIs and automations. Great data backend for low-code apps and AI pipelines.

entries.label: Baserow
entries.description: OSS self-hosted Airtable alternative with REST API, plugins, and AI-assisted features. Great data hub for LLM apps with structured data for AI agents.

entries.label: NocoBase
entries.description: OSS self-hosted platform for complex business apps with integrated AI features and strong plugin framework. Enterprise-grade data model with workflow and AI.

entries.label: Flowise
entries.description: OSS visual LLM app builder with nodes for prompts, tools, vector DBs. Core purpose is building AI agents & chatbots visually with Azure OpenAI support.

entries.label: Langflow
entries.description: Visual builder for LLM flows with native support for wide range of LLMs & vector stores. LangChain-style building with a UX editor.

entries.label: Dify
entries.description: OSS platform for LLM apps & RAG with UI for Chat, Agents, Workflows. Strong AI-native story with prompt management, agents, and tools. Enterprise RAG/agent platform.

entries.label: ILLA Builder
entries.description: OSS low-code internal-tools builder in TypeScript. Integrates with Hugging Face and AI sources out-of-the-box, supports many data sources.

entries.label: Openblocks
entries.description: OSS Retool-style platform for internal apps with 50+ components, self-hostable. REST and JS queries make AI integration straightforward.

entries.label: Windmill
entries.description: OSS workflow engine & internal tools builder. Write scripts in TypeScript/Python with generated UI & workflows. Very natural for calling LLMs and Azure DevOps.

entries.label: Automatisch
entries.description: OSS Zapier alternative with visual flows, self-hostable with many connectors. Generic HTTP and custom connectors for AI and Azure DevOps.

entries.label: APITable
entries.description: OSS API-oriented Airtable alternative with collaborative table UI and strong API. Use as data hub for prompts/configs with DevOps metadata.

entries.label: Rowy
entries.description: OSS low-code backend on Firebase/Google Cloud with spreadsheet UI and JS/TS cloud functions. Very natural to call AI APIs and Azure DevOps REST APIs from TS functions.

entries.label: PocketBase
entries.description: OSS Go-based backend with DB, auth, files, and admin UI. Great backend foundation for low-code apps, use with external automations for AI integration.

entries.label: Saltcorn
entries.description: OSS no-code web app builder on Postgres with drag-and-drop UI, workflows, and extensible plugin system. Add AI calls through plugins or HTTP integrations.

entries.label: Joget
entries.description: Java-based OSS low-code platform with workflows, forms, and native Joget AI features including TensorFlow and generative AI integration. Enterprise-focused stack.

entries.label: lsFusion
entries.description: OSS declarative low-code platform for complex business systems (ERP-style). Can call external HTTP/AI services from its language and integrate with SQL.

entries.label: Huginn
entries.description: OSS self-hosted agents platform with event graph. Good for custom AI automations if comfortable with Ruby-based config. More config-heavy, less visual.

entries.label: StackStorm
entries.description: OSS event-driven automation (IFTTT for Ops) with rules engine and workflows. Very DevOps/SRE-oriented, treat AI as action packs for incident remediation.

entries.label: PostgreSQL
entries.description:
PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development. It has earned a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance.

PostgreSQL supports advanced data types, full-text search, JSON/JSONB, and provides ACID compliance. It's highly extensible and supports custom functions, operators, and data types.

entries.label: Kubernetes
entries.description:
Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.

Key features include:
- Automated rollouts and rollbacks
- Service discovery and load balancing
- Storage orchestration
- Self-healing capabilities

Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for container orchestration in production environments.

entries.label: Python
entries.description:
Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language with dynamic semantics. Its high-level built-in data structures, combined with dynamic typing and dynamic binding, make it very attractive for Rapid Application Development.

Python's simple, easy-to-learn syntax emphasizes readability and therefore reduces the cost of program maintenance. Python supports modules and packages, which encourages program modularity and code reuse.

entries.label: Kafka
entries.description:
Apache Kafka is a distributed event streaming platform capable of handling trillions of events a day. Originally developed at LinkedIn, it has become the standard for building real-time data pipelines and streaming applications.

Kafka provides high-throughput, low-latency processing with fault-tolerance and scalability built-in. It's commonly used for:
- Real-time data processing
- Event sourcing
- Log aggregation
- Stream processing with Kafka Streams
